title: 30분이 왜 이래
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and reverb. A warm electric bass enters with melodic fills. Soft, dry kick drum and subtle percussion provide a steady pulse. Male vocals are breathy and intimate in the lower register, transitioning to a more resonant chest voice. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the guitar and the vocal melody. Key of E Major, 72 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggio with chorus]
(Hmm-mm)

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
